Checking one number from a paper is still detective work

“…achieving a low error rate of 0.0011 bits per byte in converting ABC notation to MIDI format.”
Wu et al., “Beyond Language Models: Byte Models are Digital World Simulators” (bGPT), abstract, page 1
To check it, a reviewer must find:
  • the experiment that produced 0.0011
  • the file and cell that hold it
  • the code, data, and environment that ran it
  • whether a re-run still gives 0.0011
The authors knew every answer when they wrote the paper. The links were lost when the work was flattened into prose and a folder of files.

Agents reproduce published results in only about 20–30% of cases (CORE-Bench 2024, REPRO-Bench 2025).

Quotes: Wu et al. 2024, arXiv:2402.19155, CC BY 4.02 / 16
